The condition $\pi(\pi(i)) = i$ for all $i$ means $\pi$ is an involution: every element is either fixed or paired with exactly one other element in a 2-cycle. The condition $\pi(i) \neq i$ rules out fixed points, so every element lies in a 2-cycle.

Such a $\pi$ is determined by a perfect matching of $\{1,\ldots,10\}$ into five pairs. Conversely, each perfect matching gives exactly one such permutation by swapping the two elements of each pair.

The number of perfect matchings of $2n$ points is $(2n-1)!! = (2n-1)(2n-3)\cdots 1$. For $n=5$:

$$9!! = 9 \cdot 7 \cdot 5 \cdot 3 \cdot 1 = 945.$$

ANSWER: 945
